findings.title: State tells ambulances to stop taking patients to Vista Medical Center East in Waukegan until further notice
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Vista Medical Center East went on EMS bypass at 7 a.m. Saturday and will remain on bypass until further notice
findings.access_consequences: Illinois Department of Public Health directed EMS systems to stop ambulance transports to Vista Medical Center East beginning 7:00 a.m. local time November 7, 2026 until further notice. Ambulances instead divert to other hospitals, including more distant Lake Forest Hospital and Advocate Condell. Walk-in emergency patients remain accepted; this is not a full ED closure.
findings.affected_population: Ambulance-transported emergency patients in Waukegan, northern Lake County, and Region 10 EMS catchment; EMS response and transport resources affected by longer runs.

coverage_notes.result_summary: One high-value missed emergency-access change recovered: November 7 statewide EMS bypass at Vista Medical Center East, Waukegan, Illinois. Prior 07:46 and 08:44 Care Line heartbeats had no findings and did not identify this event. Other results were older, proposed, not U.S. or territory, or lacked concrete access consequences.
coverage_notes.recall_qualification: The source was first recovered in this run, but the event began at 7:00 a.m. Central on November 7 and may predate the prior watch completion. This is a missed-development recall, not proof the announcement first occurred in the present hourly interval. The source's displayed publication timestamp has no explicit timezone.
